turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: Excuse me, do you have a minute? I did not understand the part about the deadline.

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: पक्कै पनि। पेपर शुक्रबार मध्यरातसम्म बुझाउनुपर्छ, but you can ask for an extension चाहिएमा।

turns.speaker: learner
turns.text: So can I submit it on Monday?

turns.speaker: navi
turns.text: शुक्रबार अघि मलाई email गरेर ask for an extension गर्नुहोस्। कारण बताउनुभयो भने म प्रायः हुन्छ भन्छु।
